name: berry
description: A research harness for coding agents: notices findings as they happen and records each as a checkable claim with its evidence, checks the passage of every paper a claim uses, keeps the project's conventions, gives each derivation an executable SymPy check, looks in the claims before relying on memory, and keeps a labbook PDF to follow the project step by step — plus Berry Science's paper reviewer

interface.shortDescription: Record research findings as checkable claims, check the papers they rest on, keep a labbook
